# awscc_apiportal_product (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::Product



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) The display name of the product.

### Optional

- `api_selection_configuration` (Attributes) Configuration controlling how APIs are selected for the product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_selection_configuration))
- `description` (String) A description of the product.
- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the product. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `product_arn` (String) The ARN of the product.
- `product_id` (String) The product identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the product was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--api_selection_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_selection_configuration`

Optional:

- `api_selection_mode` (String) The mode used to select APIs for the product.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product.example
  identity = {
    product_arn = "product_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `product_arn` (String) The ARN of the product

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product.example
  id = "product_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_apiportal_product.example "product_arn"
```
